data.desc: At O-I Glass, Inc. (NYSE: OI), we are proud to be one of the leading producers of glass bottles and jars around the globe. Glass is not only beautiful, it is also pure and recyclable. When collected and processed through established glass recycling systems, glass containers can be endlessly remade into new glass packaging, supporting a more circular packaging economy. Headquartered in Perrysburg, Ohio (USA), O-I is the trusted partner for a wide range of food and beverage brands. We innovate in line with customers' needs to create iconic packaging that builds brands around the world. Led by our diverse team of approximately 19,000 people across 61 plants in 18 countries, O-I achieved revenues of $6.4 billion in 2025.
